akavya-ben-mahalalel.name: Akavya ben Mahalalel
akavya-ben-mahalalel.bio: Early Tanna who, according to the Mishnah, refused to retract four of his rulings even when offered the post of head of the court.
akavya-ben-mahalalel.prompt: An elderly sage in his 70s with a long white beard and a firm, unyielding yet gentle expression, standing upright as one who will not retract his teaching; background of Jerusalem stone walls at dusk.

rav-chiyya-bar-ashi.name: Rav Ḥiyya bar Ashi
rav-chiyya-bar-ashi.bio: Babylonian Amora, a disciple of Rav who often transmits his rulings.
rav-chiyya-bar-ashi.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 50s with a dark beard streaked with grey and a careful, reverent expression, as if repeating his teacher’s ruling word for word; background of mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps.

rav-chanan-bar-ami.name: Rav Ḥanan bar Ami
rav-chanan-bar-ami.bio: Babylonian Amora who transmits rulings in the name of Shmuel.
rav-chanan-bar-ami.prompt: A Babylonian scholar in his 40s with a short dark beard and an attentive, steady look, one hand raised as if reporting a ruling; background of palm groves along the Euphrates.
